question: Into how many equal parts must the span from beam to crest end be divided for measurement?
premises: The span from beam to crest end is the measured length
This span is subjected to division
inference: The vertical span from the upper beam to the crest end is to be divided into twenty-three equal parts.
plain_english: When the span from the upper beam to the crest end is divided, it is divided into twenty-three parts.
